items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You were speaking about this O'Neal Lavasheaux... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, he's a regular dance band, you know.

ctx.x: Yeah, I never really get the door ever hearing.
Too bad. You were speaking about this O'Neal Lavasheaux, is that his name? Lavasheaux, yeah. Lavasheaux. Yeah, O'Neal Lavasheaux. Can you remember, how many was in his, it was a string band, though?
Yeah, he's a regular dance band, you know. Is it a fire piece, do you think? Fire piece, yeah. Violin, uh, violin, guitar, bass, and, no, didn't have no bass. They had drum and piano.
